evidence.mechanism: shot-02s: four canopy nodes (ochre, amber, graphite, rust) on the lower third emit amber dot streams into a thin graphite hyphal tangle; by shot-08s the right rust node fades and its line runs under a shade gradient, but the dot direction flip is hard to read.
evidence.ambition: shot-08s: blurred rust Gray-Scott spots, a hyphae tangle, dot streams and a right-edge shade gradient are layered on cream; by shot-20s eight nodes mirror radially around a ring of spots and a dense web. Still flat 2D with no material or lighting.
evidence.craft: shot-02s: blob and arc edges show visible stair-stepping at full size; palette is clean cream, ochre, rust and graphite with no clipping. By shot-20s the mirrored ring keeps the stepping and the ground is flat cream with no material or lighting.
evidence.distinctness: shot-20s: a radial ring of rust spots with eight-way mirrored dot streams and a mycorrhizal web idea not seen in the anchors; shot-08s uses reaction-diffusion blobs close in technique to anchor-10, so the novelty is in concept more than in rendering.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: composed, with four nodes on the lower third and a central web already present; shot-20s resolves into a radial mirror, though the ring edges still show stair-stepping and the frame lacks anchor-10's finish.

pairwise_justification: No median archive yet; there is no earlier piece to compare against.

critique.change: Anti-alias the Gray-Scott spot edges and the rust arc at shot-02s and shot-20s; the stair-stepped blob outlines read as low-res at full size and cost craft on every frame.

Make the reversal legible: at the 6.5 s cut, flip the dot velocity on the shaded rust node's hyphae so its amber dots visibly stream back into the web in shot-08s, rather than only fading the root tips.
Raise the dot count toward the brief's roughly 1200 at shot-08s and add a lit or shaded material pass to the nodes and web, since the frames are flat 2D with no lighting or depth.
